blocker.detail: OPT_A requires an independent per-window gold-clean ECG reference for formal-cohort sessions. The formal cohort never acquired ECG: J:/Data (72 sessions) and the pre-experiment root (10 sessions) contain only beh/mmwave/nir/rgb with zero .acq files, and D:/acq_mmwave_data is by design one participant measured repeatedly for two-machine calibration. The machine holds exactly 11 ECG-bearing sessions: 5 calibration sessions with no probe windows, 5 already-consumed development sessions, and sub-97792 which has no block1-4 probe events and is recorded as not_estimable. No participant/session-disjoint ECG reference pool exists on this machine or in the design.
blocker.consequence: VS_4, VS_5, VS_6 and VS_7 cannot be satisfied, so MMWAVE_HR_UNTOUCHED_VALIDATION_SET_V1 cannot be formed and C1/C2 must not be run. This is a missing-input blocker, not a data-engineering gap.

remediation_options.detail: Determine whether the formal cohort ever acquired ECG and, if so, retrieve it from the acquisition machine, archive drive or collaborating site, then rerun the gold-clean reference for the chosen sessions.
remediation_options.note: recommended first step; the only option that may resolve the blocker at low cost without changing the validation design

remediation_options.detail: Collect new participant/session-disjoint data with synchronized mmWave and ECG under the frozen window contract.
remediation_options.note: the only option guaranteed to yield a contract-compliant untouched validation set

remediation_options.detail: Use the sub-2_ .. sub-6_ calibration sessions under a newly defined calibration window contract.
remediation_options.note: NOT RECOMMENDED: those sessions belong to the same repeatedly-measured participant as the development set, so participant-disjointness fails, and the frozen window contract would have to change, weakening the comparison the validation exists to support

remediation_options.detail: Accept that no contract-compliant untouched validation set exists for now, keep HR/BR at HOLD and HRV BLOCKED, and suspend C1/C2 and any snapshot v2 discussion until REM_1 or REM_2 resources exist.
remediation_options.note: the honest default if no ECG source can be obtained

next_dependency: REM_1 first: determine whether the formal cohort ever acquired ECG, and retrieve it if so. If the formal cohort truly has no ECG, the choice is REM_2 (new acquisition) or REM_4 (accept absence and keep HR/BR HOLD, HRV BLOCKED). C1/C2 and snapshot v2 remain blocked meanwhile.

previous_opt_a_recommendation_was_wrong.what_was_claimed: OPT_A was described as available apart from a missing independent per-window gold-clean ECG reference, and that gap was called a data-engineering task rather than a science decision.
previous_opt_a_recommendation_was_wrong.why_wrong: The gap is a missing input, not an engineering task: the formal cohort never acquired ECG, so no formal-session ECG reference can be generated. Earlier rounds checked only whether formal sessions overlapped the development set, and never checked whether the formal cohort had ECG at all.
